*Platform:* PlayStation 3 / PS3
*Developer:* Eolith
*Publisher:* Recom
*Year:* 2010

Information from (giantbomb.com):
Chaos Breaker is a 2D high-fantasy tag-team fighting game developed by Eolith and released by Taito for arcades (running PC-based Taito Type X hardware) exclusively in Japan in 2004.

It was later ported by Recom to the *PlayStation 3, digitally released as Dark Awake: The King Has No Name* exclusively in Japan on August 5, 2010.

Information from(fightersgeneration.com):
Running on Taito's Type X arcade board, Chaos Breaker is a fantasy-themed sprite-based 2D fighting game developed by Eolith and released exclusively in Japan arcades. *The PS3 version released in Japan under its pre-production name, Dark Awake: The King Has No Name* . The character designs in the game look to be straight out of Dungeon's & Dragons or the World of Warcraft realm, featuring a mix of weapon-users, elves, orcs, and magicians. Players select a team of 3 characters, similar to The King of Fighters series. In Fact, Eolith was the same team who worked on The King of Fighters 2002. In Chaos Breaker, there are 18 playable characters, 3 bosses, and six different races featured in the game, including: Human, Dark Elf, Elf, Orc, Dwarf, and Undead.
